mapper.select: select id, client_code, client_name, description, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from ai_client_profile where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, client_code, client_name, description, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from ai_client_profile where client_code = #{clientCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_client_profile ( client_code, client_name, description, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{clientCode}, #{clientName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_client_profile set client_code = #{clientCode}, client_name = #{clientName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
